title: Spider-Man
description: With great power comes great trivia! Test your web-slinging knowledge!

questions.question: What is Spider-Man's real name?
questions.explanation: Peter Parker is the original Spider-Man, created by Stan Lee and Steve Ditko.

questions.question: Who raised Peter Parker after his parents died?
questions.explanation: Aunt May and Uncle Ben Parker raised Peter in Queens, New York.

questions.question: Peter Parker got his powers from a radioactive spider bite.
questions.explanation: A radioactive spider bit Peter during a science demonstration, granting him spider-like abilities.

questions.question: What is the name of the Daily Bugle's editor-in-chief?
questions.explanation: J. Jonah Jameson is the loud-mouthed editor who constantly slanders Spider-Man.

questions.question: Who is the second Spider-Man in the Spider-Verse?
questions.explanation: Miles Morales is the Afro-Latino teen who became Spider-Man in the Ultimate Universe.

questions.question: Venom's host before Eddie Brock was Peter Parker.
questions.explanation: Peter wore the symbiote suit first before it bonded with Eddie Brock to become Venom.

questions.question: Which villain is also known as Doctor Octopus?
questions.explanation: Otto Octavius is the brilliant scientist with four mechanical tentacle arms.

questions.question: What city does Spider-Man primarily protect?
questions.explanation: Spider-Man swings through New York City, particularly Manhattan and Queens.

questions.question: Who is the Green Goblin's true identity?
questions.explanation: Norman Osborn, founder of Oscorp, became the original Green Goblin.

questions.question: Spider-Man's webs are organic and grow from his wrists naturally.
questions.explanation: In most comics, Peter invented mechanical web-shooters. Only some film versions use organic webbing.
